description: Lieux de stationnement de la commune de Boucau is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Boucau. Parking places in the municipality of Boucau (bike, car, two wheels) from OpenStreetMap (amenity=parkingparking\spacebicycle\parkingmotorcycle\parkingcar\sharing) according to the scheme Parking de transport.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Ville de Boucau. The portal shows the English title as "Parking places in the municipality of Boucau" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Boucau. Its keywords include parking, mobilite. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
